context.target_user: Local business webmasters and technical SEO practitioners
context.problem: Auditing published website content decay, identifying broken citations (404s), and inspecting schema freshness.
context.use_case: Quarterly or monthly scheduled website crawls to generate maintenance issue logs.

rationale: In Benchmark Test 10, Screaming Frog identified a broken external citation (404), stale Last-Modified headers (>18 months), and missing schema markup. Conditioned on desktop software installation and manual CMS patching.
when_to_consider: For scheduled maintenance audits of local business websites (free up to 500 URLs).
When locating broken outbound links and inspecting technical meta freshness tags.
when_not_to_use: When expecting cloud-based automated patching inside CMS.
